description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    This course provides preservice teacher candidates with knowledge of current research and practice in mathematics education; a setting in which to apply that knowledge; and the opportunity to assess their teaching performance and formulate a plan for improvement.

Note: A grade of "C" or better must be earned in the course to be used to satisfy the general education mathematics requirement.
    
</section>
